elements.name: Artificer, Original (UA)
elements.desc:
Artificers are a key part of the world of Eberron. They illustrate the evolution of magic from a wild, unpredictable force to one that is becoming available to the masses. Magic items are part of everyday life in the Five Nations of Khorvaire; with an artificer in your party, they become part of every adventuring expedition.

Source: Unearthed Arcana 1 — Eberron

elements.name: Infuse Potions (UA)
elements.desc:
2nd-level Artificer feature.

Starting at 2nd level, you can produce magic potions. You spend 10 minutes focusing your magic on a vial of mundane water and expend a spell slot to transform it into a potion. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Infuse Scrolls (UA)
elements.desc:
2nd-level Artificer feature.

At 2nd level, you can also tap into your reserves of magical energy to create spell scrolls. You can use your Arcane Recovery ability to create a scroll instead of regaining expended spell slots. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Infuse Weapons and Armor (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Artificer feature.

Beginning at 6th level, you can produce magic weapons and armor. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Superior Artificer (UA)
elements.desc:
10th-level Artificer feature.

Starting at 10th level, you can create a second magic weapon, suit of armor, shield, or bundle of ammunition using your Infuse Weapons and Armor ability. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Master Artificer (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Artificer feature.

On reaching 14th level, your mastery of arcane magic allows you to produce a variety of magic items. You can create a single item chosen from Magic Item Tables A and B in chapter 7 of the Dungeon Master's Guide. See the side panel for the full text.
